verdict.rationale: Typesense is a search engine, and event-driven automation such as triggers or webhooks on indexing events is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no rule engine, triggers, or event-driven actions. The closest items are merchandising and curation rules that promote or hide search results, which are query-time relevance controls rather than automated actions fired on events, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
